name: Heatmap Chart
description: A framework-free Web Component that reads an HTML table and colours it in: one hue, five steps, and a scale legend that is never optional. An empty cell and a measured zero are kept apart, which is the difference an activity calendar usually loses.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: Hours against weekdays, with the five-step scale and a read-out on every cell.

variants.name: Calendar
variants.description: An activity calendar, and the difference between a quiet day and a day that has not happened.

variants.name: Cohort
variants.description: A retention triangle, long row names, and a pinned ceiling so two grids can be compared.

variants.name: Scale
variants.description: Equal slices against equal counts on a grid one cell dominates, and what each costs.

variants.name: Table
variants.description: The data contract, and why a grid of colours needs its table more than any other chart.

variants.name: States
variants.description: Nothing at all, every reading zero, a single cell, refetching, and a failure.
